title: Exact Deconvolution for Schwartz Kernels: From Polynomial Automorphisms to Recursive Inversion in Tempered Distributions
summary: In this work, we construct an explicit, theoretically rigorous deconvolution method that relies entirely on iterative forward convolutions, thus can be numerically implemented. We first prove that convolution with an even Schwartz kernel acts as an automorphism on the vector space of finite-degree polynomials. Exploiting the parity of the kernel, we derive an exact algebraic inverse for this space, expressed uniquely as a finite linear combination of repeated convolutions.
